scientific limitations/integrity: Exact orthogonal hyperplane projection three-volume of the explicitly normalized regular four-dimensional 24-cell only; no affine-invariant generalization, approximate equality stability, or general parallelohedron bound claimed. Primary facet data and Cauchy formula are previously known. The new theorem supplies the exact full directional function and both extremizer classifications. Numeric projection tests are cross-checks only; the proof is analytic.
title: The regular 24-cell has exactly 24 least-bright and 192 most-bright projection directions
